cohort: The study included 300 women who gave birth in 2019 at the University of Szeged, comprising 100 women with preterm deliveries and 200 women with term deliveries.
finding: Higher perceived stress was associated with an increased risk of maternal depressive symptoms in both preterm and term delivery groups, and newborn complications were linked to increased depression risk in women with term deliveries.
gest_age: Preterm deliveries (<37 weeks) and term deliveries (>=37 weeks)
